G1_unambiguity.justification: The linear-functional condition unambiguously means that the selected difference vectors force all designated basis vectors to have equal values.

G2_completeness.justification: All necessary input bounds, formats, feasibility guarantees, output requirements, and relevant edge cases are specified.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Selecting vectors whose differences constrain a linear functional to equal values is exactly equivalent to selecting cabling edges that connect all required sites, with the same costs and bounds.

G4_naturalness.justification: The statement is coherent and readable, though the procurement and objective-target terminology feels somewhat contrived compared with the original cabling framing.
